integrity: The proof is analytic and uses the stated finite Bourgain selection theorem as its only non-elementary input. No finite experiment is used to certify the universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Constants are order-sharp but not numerically optimized; the lower construction is a worst-case sharpness result and does not identify exact random-prefix tail probabilities.
title: Sharp nested all-cardinality profile for Bourgain \(\Lambda(p)\) selection
